subject: English First Additional Language

source.subtopic: Week 6: /b/ (bed, bat, beg, bin, bun); differentiates b and h; identifies rhyming words

show.line: Listen. b, b, bed. b, b, bat! Bed starts with b.

rounds.prompt: Which one starts with b, as in bed?
Say the sound with me. b, as in bat!
Is it b or h? Listen. Bin.
Listen. b, a, t. What word is it?
Does it start with b or h? Sort the pictures.

hints: Lips together, then pop. b, b, b.
Rhyming words sound the same at the end.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find a word that rhymes with bat.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Bin does not rhyme with bat. Hat rhymes with bat.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's listen together. Bat, hat. They sound the same at the end!

parent_line: Can hear the b sound, blend words like bat and find rhyming words.
